verdict.rationale: Brex's partner onboarding docs say approved partners receive credentials for a staging environment, so a first-party non-production test environment exists. It appears to be gated behind a partner application and is documented in only one line. There is no detail on how it isolates data from production, and nothing shows it is available to regular API-token or MCP users. Missing for 10: self-serve sandbox access for general API/MCP users, documentation of staging data isolation and parity with production, sandbox support for the MCP server or webhooks, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: Once your application is approved, you'll receive credentials for the staging environment using SendSafely.
